reports.title: Talos Energy Announces Third Quarter 2026 Operational and Financial Results

lines: Increased midpoint of full-year 2026 production guidance to 69 MBo/d and 93.5 MBoe/d, inclusive of the completed Gulf of America acquisition, non-core shelf divestment and impact from Hurricane Isaias in early October.
Talos has increased its full-year 2026 production guidance and now expects production to range from 68 to 70 MBo/d and 92.5 to 94.5 MBoe/d.
